status: axe C0: live default. IBM C1: wired, OPT-IN (V3_CHECKER + package). QualWeb lane: implemented default-on (V3_QUALWEB=0 disables) — final validation (pre/post 581 + 218 + suite) in progress at generation time.

semantics.axe: Runs in-page at collection. Surfaced findings (sc-wholesale / rule-allowlist / best-practice-map) become shadow checkerFindings; decided ones promote to PROVISIONAL barriers on owned facets (AXE_SC_FAMILY: 4.1.2 name-role-value, 1.1.1 non-text-content, 2.4.4 link-purpose, 1.4.1 use-of-color). review:true and axe-incomplete are LLM priors, never decisions.
semantics.ibm: SC-scoped, not ACT-id-scoped: hard cross-signals only for SCs 1.4.12/2.5.3 (VIOLATION+FAIL), triage priors for 1.4.1/1.3.3. Never authoritative, never a disposition.
semantics.qualweb: ACT-id-scoped via its own metadata (data/qualweb-act-map.json). failed assertion -> AUTHORITATIVE barrier on the policy families; definitive silence (no failed AND no warning) -> clear ONLY on clear:true families (no cross-rule sibling); warning blocks clearing. Rules without a QW_POLICY entry contribute rule-level eval signals but no ledger disposition.
